title: Misawa disc flips on its edge

tellings.quote: Msawa, Japan, 1952 training uh exercise. Uh guys flying doing intercepts and he sees a disc come up to his plane

plain: In 1952, during a training exercise at Misawa in Japan, a pilot practising intercepts saw a disc rise up to his plane and flip onto its edge. A commentator named Marik von Rennenkampff tells this, without naming a source, as one of the cases he puts forward in a debate with the skeptic Mick West.
